name: Bottom Menu
description: A bottom toolbar where every icon owns a small panel above it: notes and capture shortcuts, a search field with quick filters, notification categories, account links, and a theme switch. Moving between icons morphs the panel's width and height while the old content blurs out and the new one sharpens in.
interactionNotes: Click an icon to open its panel; click the same icon again, click anywhere outside or press Escape to close it. Picking another icon swaps the panel in place: the old content fades out with a blur while the panel's width and height spring to the new size, so the bar never jumps. Icons report `aria-expanded`, the theme choices use `aria-pressed`, and every control has a visible focus ring.

props.name: autoPreview
props.description: Site preview only — the toolbar tours its own panels and closes again. Leave it off in normal use.

props.name: accentColor
props.description: Tint of the active icon and the picked theme row; mixed into the page, so any accent stays readable in both themes.

tips: Place it at the bottom of a screen: the panel opens upwards from the bar, so the component needs free space above it.
Every panel is described at the top of the file as a plain array, so changing labels, icons or adding a sixth icon is a data edit rather than a JSX edit.
The panel measures itself with a hidden copy of the content, so the size animation needs no measuring library and no explicit widths from you.
Colors are shadcn tokens (`background`, `border`, `muted`, `accent`, `foreground`, `destructive`), so it follows the project's light and dark themes with no extra wiring.
The theme row only highlights the choice in its own state; connect it to your theme provider when you want the click to change the site.
The panel closes on Escape as well as on an outside click, so the bar never traps the keyboard.
